privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How STOA handles account, learning, support, and service data.

dataWeCollect.title: Data we collect
dataWeCollect.body: STOA may collect account data, role, contact details, student learning activity, questions, uploaded homework metadata, support requests, feedback, analytics events, and frontend error reports.

studentLearning.title: Student learning data
studentLearning.body: Learning data can include recent questions, conversation metadata, weak topics, teacher-support requests, report summaries, and progress signals used to support the student and inform parents.

visibility.title: Parent and teacher visibility
visibility.body: Parents can see learning summaries, reports, focus areas, and teacher involvement. Teachers can see the context needed to answer a help request, including the relevant question and prior explanation.

useRetention.title: Use, retention, and deletion
useRetention.body: Data is used to operate STOA, provide learning support, prepare reports, handle support, monitor reliability, and improve the service. Retention and deletion requests are handled according to STOA's operational policy and applicable law.

thirdParties.title: Service partners
thirdParties.body: Hosting, authentication, analytics, monitoring, payment, and support partners may process limited data under appropriate service agreements.

terms.title: Terms
terms.description: The conditions for using STOA learning support, subscriptions, and service access.

learningSupport.title: Learning support
learningSupport.body: STOA supports learning with explanations, practice, and access to teacher-backed help. It does not replace school instruction, parent judgment, or professional educational decisions.

accuracy.title: Explanations and outcomes
accuracy.body: Learning explanations can be incomplete or incorrect. STOA does not guarantee grades, exam results, or specific outcomes. Important work should be checked by the student, parent, teacher, or tutor.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable use
acceptableUse.body: Users must not upload illegal, unsafe, highly sensitive, or unrelated content. Homework uploads should be limited to material needed for learning support.

subscriptions.title: Trials and subscriptions
subscriptions.body: Free trials, quotas, subscriptions, cancellations, refunds, and payment workflows are shown at sign-up, checkout, or account management where applicable.

serviceChanges.title: Service changes
serviceChanges.body: STOA may change, pause, or terminate access where needed to protect students, data, reliability, and support quality. Contact support for questions or account requests.
